detail: Instrument exactly the unread-response frontier: same protected Response body reader emits fixed streaming phase only after first nonempty chunk, preserves split UTF-8 and reader release; independent one-way1Hz renderer pulse distinguishes a live JS event loop during callback wait from renderer silence.
